# Evaluation results (generated by `python3 eval/run_eval.py --report-only`)

> **Read this first.** n = 10 synthetic findings written by the same person who built the pipeline, labelled by one person, with no inter-rater agreement and no time split. This is a **smoke set, not a held-out evaluation**. Differences of one finding are noise. Real scanner output and the planted-vulnerability ground truth are not available yet (R2/R3 deliverables).

Ground truth: `eval/ground_truth.jsonl` (sha256 `7d552c524db6…`). Raw per-finding outputs: `eval/results/*.jsonl`. Models: only those installed locally were run; `qwen2.5-coder:14b` and `llama3.1:8b` from the plan were **not** run.

## Bake-off and ablations

| Configuration | Precision | Recall | F1 | Abstain | Confidently wrong | Unusable output | p50 latency (s) | Ungrounded claims produced → reaching a human |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Heuristic keyword baseline (no LLM) | 0.75 | 0.5 | 0.6 | 0.0 | 4 | 0 | n/a | n/a |
| llama3:latest, full pipeline (schema decoding + validator) | 0.714 | 0.833 | 0.769 | 0.2 | 2 | 0 | 2.51 | 2 → 0 |
| llama3:latest, **no validator** (counterfactual, same run) | 0.714 | 0.833 | 0.769 | 0.2 | 2 | 0 | 2.51 | 2 → 2 |
| gemma2:latest, full pipeline (schema decoding + validator) | 1.0 | 0.5 | 0.667 | 0.5 | 0 | 0 | 4.54 | 2 → 0 |
| llama3:latest, JSON mode, no schema | 0.75 | 0.5 | 0.6 | 0.5 | 1 | 0 | 2.37 | 4 → 0 |
| llama3:latest, no format constraint | 0.75 | 0.5 | 0.6 | 0.5 | 1 | 0 | 2.38 | 4 → 0 |

Definitions: precision = TP/(TP+FP) over answered findings; **recall = TP / all expected TPs (an abstention on a real TP counts as a miss)**; *confidently wrong* = answered, not abstained, and wrong; *unusable* = the model's output could not be parsed. Abstaining (`NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW`) is a reported success outcome, not an error.

## Determinism (temperature 0, seed 42)

- `llama3:latest`: 100% of findings identical (verdict + fix text) across two runs
- `gemma2:latest`: 100% of findings identical (verdict + fix text) across two runs

## Honest limitations

- n = 10, one labeller, synthetic rows: no confidence intervals are meaningful.
- The validator only proves claims against the scanner record, the MITRE CWE catalogue (v4.20) and a 7-CVE sample registry. It rejects real-but-unlisted CVEs on purpose (fail closed), which can produce false abstains.
- Priority is computed in code from severity/KEV/EPSS; the ground-truth rows carry no `severity_norm`, so priority is not scored here.
- Models are small local models (8-9B, Q4). Confident errors happen (see the table); the human-review path exists for that.
- Peak RAM was not measured; only the `ollama ps` size above.
